positive_findings: The exact contract/table/result/spec bytes are mutually consistent; all ten ROM rows and deltas are unique and the exact current RTL decimal case arms are IDs 0 through 9 only.
IDs 10 through 15 reach the default fail-closed arm in the exact reviewed RTL source. The sticky protocol_error behavior requires reset after an illegal configuration.
All ten exact packed canonical rows admit and the other 3610 legacy frozen-delta encodings reject, including all 3577 M35-r3 review-noncanonical tuples and 33 hole/order variants.

The 100070 count is independently derived as 10 descriptors times (7 edges plus 10000 seeded values), not trusted as a report constant; every product and the complete vector/product digest were recomputed.
The signed32 extrema are present and prove the full-domain signed56 product range for the positive frozen UQ0.24 thresholds.

The r3 two-stage ready/valid, backpressure, epoch capture, empty-boundary release and configuration-loaded control expressions are present in r4; the only functional configuration change in the exact source is canonical ROM decode and ID latching. This remains a static migration audit, not execution proof.
The 64-bit RTL fingerprint is correctly documented as a short non-cryptographic diagnostic. Full table SHA and exact RTL source SHA, rather than the fingerprint alone, bind this review.

findings.evidence: Two constructed mutants pass analyze_m35_r4_canonical_descriptor.audit_rtl: an illegal 4'hA legal case arm inserted before default, and a term-0 sign control miswired to config_term_negative_q[1]. A direct canonical decimal ROM-row shift mutation is rejected. Thus the parser proves the ten parsed decimal rows but does not prove exhaustive 4-bit decode or arithmetic connectivity.
findings.impact: The exact reviewed RTL source is manually consistent, and the milestone appropriately withholds VCS correctness. However its static audit cannot serve as a fail-closed rebuild oracle for the claim that all IDs 10..15 reject or that the RTL realizes the model arithmetic.
findings.required_fix: Before VCS admission, replace lexical parsing with a generated ROM manifest plus exhaustive executable decode/product vectors for all 16 IDs and all ten descriptors; independently miter actual handshake outputs. Bind the exact source, TB, vectors, logs and exit receipt.

findings.evidence: The r4 analyzer validates the checkpoint SHA string through the hashed r3 result but never resolves or hashes checkpoint_epoch35.pth. This review independently found and hashed the local checkpoint bytes as 4f33e086...5158.
findings.impact: Current identity is corroborated, but a relocated build can pass without the checkpoint bytes and cannot independently re-extract the ten thresholds from this milestone alone.
findings.required_fix: The VCS/system admission should anchor a relative checkpoint path and SHA, plus the extraction script and a checkpoint-to-descriptor manifest, or explicitly label r4 as consuming an upstream sealed threshold artifact rather than verifying checkpoint extraction.

findings.evidence: Static comparison confirms the r3 ready chain, epoch capture and safe release controls were transplanted. No r4 TB/SVA or actual cycle trace covers full backpressure, simultaneous boundary events, illegal-ID recovery, release/reload, reset-under-stall, conservation or ordering. descriptor_legal also reports the live candidate ID while loaded_descriptor_id reports latched state, which needs an explicit interface definition.
findings.impact: II=1, eight outputs/cycle, lossless backpressure and epoch/release behavior remain design intent rather than admitted RTL behavior.
findings.required_fix: Run an isolated exact-SHA VCS milestone with all 16 IDs, continuous bursts, adversarial stalls, release/reload, reset-under-stall and a transaction ledger replayed by an independent Python miter.

findings.evidence: The ten-entry ID ROM is a compile-time specialization for one H67 epoch-35 image. The milestone supplies no multi-checkpoint coverage, rebuild-cost result, or measured r3-versus-r4 area/timing comparison.
findings.impact: This is a sound canonicality/attack-surface closure and may reduce configuration hardware, but reviewers can reasonably characterize it as ordinary constant specialization or checkpoint overfitting. It adds no arithmetic speedup by itself and cannot carry a DATE novelty or headline claim.
findings.required_fix: Position it as a compiler/deployment mechanism subordinate to the Local/Motion architecture; demonstrate automatic regeneration on multiple checkpoint/table images and only claim area/timing benefits after same-flow Formality-passed A/B evidence.

findings.evidence: No artifact maps each Local/Motion operator instance and epoch to descriptor_id, proves that runtime scheduling never requests an illegal/stale ID, or connects the exact integer product to RNE, bias, saturation and trained accuracy.
findings.impact: The canonical engine cannot yet be consumed as an end-to-end accelerator primitive, and no integrated speedup, accuracy, PPA or energy claim follows.
findings.required_fix: Add a checkpoint-derived operator-to-ID schedule with epoch/version checks, then close fixed-point and full-system trace miters before M39/M40 headline consumption.

specialization_reviewer_risk.area_boundary: The raw configuration checker was removed, but a 10-way decode and descriptor registers remain. No area reduction is admitted until same-library, same-constraint, Formality-passed r3/r4 A/B synthesis.
specialization_reviewer_risk.generality_boundary: A checkpoint or threshold table change requires regenerating all contract/ROM/source identities and repeating verification. The current proof covers one H67 epoch-35 image only.
specialization_reviewer_risk.recommended_paper_position: Use canonical-ID specialization to make the more important Local/Motion execution mechanism implementable and fail-closed; do not count it as an independent speedup or primary architectural contribution.

next_gate.permitted: An isolated VCS run using exactly the reviewed RTL SHA and a new exhaustive ID/protocol/product oracle, followed by an independent observed-output miter and sealed receipt.
next_gate.forbidden: DC, STA, Formality, PPA, power, integrated Local/Motion speedup, external accelerator comparison, DATE headline or best-paper claim on the basis of M35-r4 model/static evidence.

claim_boundary.admitted: Exact current-source ten-row canonical table identity; exact packed-row membership; rejection of 3610 legacy alternate tuples in the Python compatibility adapter; independently recomputed 100070 integer identities and signed56 extrema; static r3-to-r4 protocol-control transplantation.
claim_boundary.not_admitted: Semantic RTL decode or arithmetic correctness, VCS protocol behavior, II=1, eight results/cycle, synthesis area/timing, Formality, system descriptor scheduling, RNE/bias/saturation, accuracy, speedup, PPA, power, energy, external comparisons, DATE headline or best-paper status.
